Final Reflection

Table tennis is small, fast, and deep. It began as an indoor game, but it became a global sport. It is easy to start, but hard to master. The best players are not all the same. Waldner showed reading and clever changes. Deng Yaping showed speed, courage, and mental strength. Ma Long showed the value of a complete game. The bigger idea is useful outside sport too. Power matters, but control matters. Speed matters, but calm thinking matters. Great skill often comes from seeing small details that other people miss.
